description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Brivo is hiring recent college graduates as Software Engineers for its Video or Access teams. The role involves building and deploying security products, APIs, and MCP servers, collaborating with product teams, and contributing to cloud video surveillance and physical security platforms.
New Grad Software Engineer building AI-enabled security products, APIs, and MCP servers through rapid prototyping and production iteration

Responsibilities:
• Leverage the latest AI models to rapidly prototype, develop, and iterate on next-generation security products, APIs, and MCP servers
• Collaborate within small, agile product teams alongside other top-notch product engineers to test new ideas and push code to production on a weekly—or even daily—basis
• Capitalize on the powerful, newly integrated Brivo and Eagle Eye platform to build everything from bespoke applications for boutique clients to rock-solid, enterprise-grade security suites
• Apply your deep curiosity to maximize our platform's potential. No prior industry experience is required—just an unstoppable drive to learn, iterate, and create

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• Working knowledge of at least one of: **Python, Java, or Node.js/TypeScript** (coursework, internships, or personal projects all count)
• Basic understanding of databases and SQL
• Comfort using Linux and running shell commands
• Familiarity with Git or another version control system
• Strong curiosity, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail

Preferred:
• Intro-level knowledge of networking concepts (IP, ports, protocols, APIs)
• Experience with cloud platforms, especially AWS
• Exposure to Docker or containerized environments
• Familiarity with REST APIs and HTTP fundamentals
• Experience writing automated tests (e.g., Playwright)
• Exposure to authentication/authorization concepts (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Auth0)
